cash_quality.warning: Not normalized owner FCF because FY2026 cash taxes were unusually low and working-capital/credit-program flows are material.
cash_quality.method: Low case treats acquired-intangible amortization as an economic cost; high case adds it back as a noncash acquisition accounting charge. Both retain SBC expense because GAAP net income already includes SBC.

rough_roic.caveat: Diagnostic only; customer funds, lending assets, acquisition accounting and segment financing make a textbook ROIC denominator imperfect.
